title: An ensemble model approach for identifying pulmonary tuberculosis on chest X-ray.
summary: Ensemble models detect pulmonary tuberculosis on chest radiographs with independent testing.
ai_technology: Transfer-learned CNNs and performance-weighted ensemble for chest-X-ray TB classification
organization: Affiliated Hospital of Integrated Traditional Chinese and Western Medicine; Nanjing University of Chinese Medicine; Jiangsu Province Academy of Traditional Chinese Medicine

evidence.tested: Nine transfer-learned CNNs and four ensembles were evaluated on internal and independent external CXR data. Performance-weighted averaging achieved external-validation AUC 0.880 and F1 0.861; the best single model, VGG19, achieved AUC 0.853.
evidence.unknown: Performance fell on independent external validation; the study did not establish deployment benefit.
evidence.ai_role: Classifies chest X-rays for pulmonary tuberculosis; the ensemble weights nine CNN prediction scores, with weights based on internal-test AUC.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
